content.title: Arvada Kite Festival
content.summary: The Arvada Kite Festival will take place on Sunday, April 12, 2026, from 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. at Stenger Sports Complex, celebrating its 21st year with activities including kite demonstrations, local vendor booths, and free kids' activities. The festival will feature a winning t-shirt design by Vihaan Juvvalapalem, with proceeds benefiting Ralston House, and attendees are reminded of designated Kite Free Zones for safety.

## Arvada Kite Festival Youth T-Shirt Design Contest

Thanks to everyone who participated in the Arvada Kite Festival Youth T-Shirt Design Contest!

The winner, as voted on by the community, is Vihaan Juvvalapalem. Congratulations, Vihaan! T-shirts featuring Vihaan's design will be available for purchase at the Kite Festival, and those who can't attend can [purchase a t-shirt online](https://www.customink.com/fundraising/ralstonhouseKiteFestival?fbclid=IwY2xjawRFAU1leHRuA2FlbQIxMABicmlkETFPaGtjTGhpZ01QbW1tZjJwc3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABHrLT5hqp6e9yn1pYc-uGzMB7xOMaC6Y2Sr3NnDT-SbSHpOeGhQDZIwuhrNRc_aem_ITbMmz9JiEG2nZJUxmT-Zg). All proceeds from the sale of the shirts will benefit Ralston House.

![Child’s drawing of the Arvada Kite Festival with mountains, tents, and people flying kites.](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=7211)

Thank you to everyone who participated, and congratulations to our other two finalists:

- [Warren Cockrum, Age 9](https://www.arvadaco.gov/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=7212)
- [River Levy, Age 12](https://www.arvadaco.gov/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=7210)

## Arvada Kite Festival set for Sunday, April 12, 2026

The Arvada Kite Festival is the City of Arvada's flagship event hosted each spring by the Arvada Festivals Commission. Join us to celebrate 21 years of high-flying fun in 2026!

![Arvada Kite Festival logo](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=2626)

- ### **Date**: Sunday, April 12, 2026
- ### **When**: 11 a.m. to 4 p.m.
- ### **Where**: Stenger Sports Complex - 58th Avenue and Quail Street

Soaring kites! Colorful kites! Majestic kites! There’s no better way to celebrate spring than the Arvada Kite Festival. Bring your own kite or buy a kite at the event.

Plan to spend the day flying kites, shopping local vendors, eating great food and listening to good music. Bring your chairs or blankets and plan on staying the day.

## Kite Festival Activities

- Kite demonstrations by the Rocky Mountain Kite Association
- Over 100 local vendor booths
- More food trucks this year than ever!
- Free kids activities: face painting and inflatables
- The Denver Museum of Nature and Science's [Discovery Station](https://www.dmns.org/programs-and-events/discovery-station/)
- [Nurf Terf Zone](https://www.nurfterf.com/)
- [Make-A-Kite Classes are offered by the Majestic View Nature Center](https://secure.rec1.com/CO/arvada-co/catalog/index?filter=dGFiJTVCMTU4NjglNUQ9MSZzZWFyY2g9JnJlbnRhbCU1QmZyb20lNUQ9JnJlbnRhbCU1QnRvJTVEPSZlNzFjN2VlNTMwNzlhZDJkMzc4MGFmMzliYjc0MzQ0Nj1hOTA0OTI0NTAzNDA4ZGFiNmM5YzlmOWQxYWYyMDE2YQ==) on Friday, April 10 and Saturday, April 11

## Parking Information

Parking gates will open at 10:45 a.m. Parking is first come, first served.

Don't forget we'll have free bike valet by Bike Friendly Arvada. Ride your bike to the event and avoid stressing about parking!

**Pets and BBQ grills not allowed at this event.**

## New designated Kite Free Zones

To help ensure a safe and enjoyable experience for everyone at the Arvada Kite Festival on Sunday, April 12, **designated Kite Free Zones** will be in place throughout the event area. These zones are located in areas with overhead power lines, where flying kites can pose a serious safety risk. All No Fly Zones will be clearly marked, and we ask that attendees carefully follow posted signage and guidance from event staff. Our volunteers are on-site to help direct you to safe flying areas and keep the festival running smoothly—please treat them with courtesy and respect.

By working together and honoring these safety zones, we can keep the skies fun, safe, and open for all!

![Map of kite festival grounds, including new Kite Free Zones under power lines](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=7392)

## Volunteer at the Arvada Kite Festival

The Arvada Festivals Commission is looking for volunteers to help out during the Kite Festival. Whether you can help greet guests, assist with activities, or support event operations, your time makes a big difference! Please sign up for a volunteer shift and be part of a tradition that brings our community together.

### [Volunteer](https://www.signupgenius.com/go/20F0445A8A928A0FF2-61128145-kite#/ "Volunteer Sign Up")
